points: The 11 months with records range from January (47,828) through November (46,670); December has no source rows and is not a confirmed zero.
February recorded the lowest count at 44,752 calls, while July was the highest at 59,349 calls, a difference of 14,597 calls (32.6%).

Call volume increased from February to July, with the largest single-month jump occurring between May (53,299) and June (50,357) — actually a decrease of 2,942 calls — and the biggest rise between June (50,357) and July (59,349) at +8,992 calls.

From July through November, calls declined each month: July (59,349) to August (54,913, -4,436), August to September (53,450, -1,463), September to October (49,794, -3,656), and October to November (46,670, -3,124).
The overall 11-month trend shows a net decrease of 1,158 calls from January (47,828) to November (46,670), or -2.4%.
